name: Nakosoji Mamiya
source:
Mother of twin daughters, Airi and Rin. Quiet and gentle in nature, yet strong-willed at her core. Her slow, refined speech and manner of speaking that reveals her firm resolve have earned her many male fans.

Currently a city council member in Z City, rumors are circulating that she will run as an independent candidate to carry on the legacy of her husband, a House of Representatives member who was stabbed to death by a foreign national.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=29165&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
